verdict.rationale: The IRS publishes a processing clock for one transaction type: e-file provider application approval can take up to 45 days. That is a static upper bound, not a current or live processing time, and the evidence shows no published processing times for founder-core transactions such as mailed or faxed SS-4 EIN applications or 83(b) elections. Missing for 10: current or regularly updated processing-time figures, coverage of founder transactions (EIN by mail/fax, Form 15620/83(b)), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: it can take up to 45 days from the date of submission for the IRS to approve your e-file application
